label: NB-IoT

payload_bytes.label: Payload
payload_bytes.description: Actual encoded application bytes, distinct from upper-layer overhead, MAC/RLC segmentation, granted NPUSCH/NPDSCH TBS and coded/repeated radio airtime. No universal8/1500byte NB-IoT payload or peak-rate capacity.

target_bus_load_percent.label: Ziel-Buslast
target_bus_load_percent.description: Zielwert fuer die aus Routing, Payload, Zyklus und Bitrate berechnete Buslast.

nbi_edition.description: Actual reviewed Release18 source set; older or other editions require an independent schema.
nbi_edition.label: edition

nbi_rat.description: Actual terrestrial E-UTRA radio band versus independently qualified NR/NTN. No NTN fallback.
nbi_rat.label: rat

nbi_category.description: Actual combined UL/DL category; NB2 also advertises NB1, not arbitrary mixed pairs.
nbi_category.label: category

nbi_role.description: Actual UE versus serving base station; UE RF limits do not define eNodeB output.
nbi_role.label: role

nbi_direction.description: Actual scheduled direction with its own grants, blocks and repetitions.
nbi_direction.label: direction

nbi_deployment.description: Actual standalone, guardband or inband PCI relation, not an industry template.
nbi_deployment.label: deployment

nbi_duplex.description: Actual serving-band FDD with typeB half duplex, or TDD. Full FDD is not NB1/NB2.
nbi_duplex.label: duplex

nbi_channel.description: Actual NPUSCH data or uplink control, or NPDSCH unicast; other services need separate grant rules.
nbi_channel.label: channel

nbi_grant_kind.description: Actual reviewed DCI allocation versus independently qualified PUR/EDT/SIB/multiTB.
nbi_grant_kind.label: grant kind

nbi_modulation.description: Actual grant-selected modulation and optional NB2 capability.
nbi_modulation.label: modulation

nbi_ns.description: Actual network-signalled NS_04/06 has US band edge rules; no regulatory permission from band eligibility.
nbi_ns.label: ns

nbi_power_class.description: Actual commissioned UE power class; nominal maximum not current radiated output.
nbi_power_class.label: power class

nbi_nas_mode.description: Actual NB-S1 EPS versus independently registered NB-N1/other core procedures.
nbi_nas_mode.label: nas mode

nbi_ciot_path.description: Actual accepted CP, UP or registered data path. CP can carry IP, non-IP or Ethernet; not automatically UDP.

nbi_pdn_type.description: Actual negotiated PDN data type, separate from radio PHY.

nbi_core_endpoint.description: Actual SCEF non-IP versus SGi binding or other independently registered core endpoint.
nbi_core_endpoint.label: core endpoint

nbi_rrc_state.description: Actual RRC idle/connected state for power saving and data transfer.
nbi_rrc_state.label: rrc state

nbi_emm_state.description: Actual normal registered service versus other NAS state.
nbi_emm_state.label: emm state

nbi_timer_receiver.description: Actual NETWORK interpretation of request versus UE interpretation of received grant; long units differ.
nbi_timer_receiver.label: timer receiver

nbi_nas_procedure_class.description: Actual applicable EMM/ESM timer table class; additions are not application timeout defaults.

nbi_revision.description: Actual device/firmware/network edition and compatible radio, MAC/RLC/RRC/NAS version references.

nbi_registered_source.description: Actual independent schema for another edition/RAT/category/grant/service; no assumed NR/NTN timing.

nbi_device_source.description: Actual supported band/category/multi-tone/HARQ/optional QAM and certified device capability.

nbi_binding_source.description: Actual canonical UE/cell and explicit independently registered upper/core/backhaul binding.

nbi_network_source.description: Actual serving-cell deployment, admission and resource configuration.
nbi_network_source.label: network source

nbi_regulatory_source.description: Actual jurisdiction, approved spectrum and deployment permission, not universal frequencies.

nbi_physical_source.description: Actual RF link budget, antenna, receiver, interference, thermal and spectral evidence.

nbi_power_source.description: Actual band/power/MPR/A-MPR/tolerance and test conditions; band88 absent from selected class table.

nbi_band_qualification_source.description: Actual band footnote/special regional restriction qualification, including24/65/66/70/74.

nbi_grant_source.description: Actual DCI/RAR subcarrier/resource/TBS/repetition and search-space context, not invented allocation.

nbi_airtime_source.description: Actual coded/repeated resource mapping including postponements, guards and control overhead.

nbi_mac_rlc_source.description: Actual MAC/RLC/PDCP segmentation, retry, queues and complete protocol resources.
nbi_mac_rlc_source.label: mac rlc source

nbi_nas_source.description: Actual accepted attach/TAU core context, PSM/eDRX and protected signalling evidence.
nbi_nas_source.label: nas source

nbi_application_source.description: Actual application codec/segmentation and functional endpoints, separate from radio TBS.
nbi_application_source.label: application source

nbi_security_source.description: Actual protected subscription references, AS/NAS and independently protected application path.
nbi_security_source.label: security source

nbi_capacity_source.description: Actual complete radio/core/backhaul/server capacity evidence; category peaks are not service rate.

nbi_acceptance_source.description: Actual E2E/freshness/safety acceptance, distinct from radio or NAS acknowledgements.

nbi_ue_ref.description: Actual commissioned UE reference; no fabricated IMSI/IMEI/keys or default subscriber.
nbi_ue_ref.label: ue ref

nbi_cell_ref.description: Actual network-assigned serving cell reference, not default CAN identity.
nbi_cell_ref.label: cell ref

nbi_subscription_key_ref.description: Actual protected credential reference, never key contents or a default credential.
nbi_subscription_key_ref.label: subscription key ref

nbi_frequency_error_source.description: Actual relative eNodeB carrier measurement and72/tone-slot averaging, not oscillator catalog ppm.
nbi_frequency_error_source.label: frequency error source

nbi_tdd_source.description: Actual TS36.211/331 UL/DL/special-subframe/guard configuration and eligible carrier.
nbi_tdd_source.label: tdd source

nbi_timer_source.description: Actual requested/received raw NAS IE, receiver, presence, protection and latest negotiation.
nbi_timer_source.label: timer source

nbi_reachability_source.description: Actual paging occasions/PTW/PSM/core buffering and complete downlink delivery bound.
nbi_reachability_source.label: reachability source

nbi_band.description: Actual eligible terrestrial E-UTRA band; NR n-bands need their own qualified schema.
nbi_band.label: band

nbi_carrier_mhz.description: Actual direction-dependent radio carrier, qualified by band/NS and footnotes.
nbi_carrier_mhz.label: carrier mhz

nbi_channel_khz.description: Normative NB1/NB2 channel200kHz, not the180kHz grid or useful throughput.

nbi_grid_khz.description: Normative180kHz transmission grid, separate from serving channel200kHz.
nbi_grid_khz.label: grid khz

nbi_grid_tones.description: Normative grid48 at3.75kHz or12 at15kHz, not allocated tones.
nbi_grid_tones.label: grid tones

nbi_tones.description: Actual contiguous allocated tones1/3/6/12;3.75kHz supports onlysingle-tone.
nbi_tones.label: tones

nbi_tone_index.description: Actual DCI subcarrier indication;3.75kHz0..47,15kHz0..18, remaining reserved.
nbi_tone_index.label: tone index

nbi_first_tone.description: Actual first tone in the contiguous DCI allocation, not a global channel number.
nbi_first_tone.label: first tone

nbi_slot_ms.description: Normative UL slot2ms at3.75kHz or0.5ms at15kHz.

nbi_symbols_per_slot.description: Normative seven SC-FDMA symbols in selected NPUSCH resource unit.
nbi_symbols_per_slot.label: symbols per slot

nbi_ru_slots.description: Normative selected NPUSCH RU16/8/4/2slots, not application cycle.

nbi_ru_ms.description: Nominal occupied selected RUslots*slot duration; guards/postponements not included.

nbi_ru_index.description: Actual DCI resource assignment index0..7 mapping1/2/3/4/5/6/8/10RUs.
nbi_ru_index.label: ru index

nbi_ru_count.description: Actual granted RUcount, not alwaysone nor 7 forindex7.
nbi_ru_count.label: ru count

nbi_rep_index.description: Actual NPUSCH DCI repetition index0..7 or NPDSCH0..15, not retry limit.
nbi_rep_index.label: rep index

nbi_repetitions.description: Actual granted transmission repetitions; ULDCI1..128, DL separatelyqualified.
nbi_repetitions.label: repetitions

nbi_tbs_index.description: Actual modulation-dependent TBS index, distinct from MCS and application bytes.
nbi_tbs_index.label: tbs index

nbi_mcs_index.description: Actual DCI MCS, single-tone0..10 table or multi-tone/DCI special16QAM context.
nbi_mcs_index.label: mcs index

nbi_qam16_index.description: Actual DCI MCSfor16QAM index with deployment-specific TBS offset.
nbi_qam16_index.label: qam16 index

nbi_sf_index.description: Actual NPDSCH resource assignment index0..7; no SIB1table fallback.
nbi_sf_index.label: sf index

nbi_sf_count.description: Actual NPDSCH1/2/3/4/5/6/8/10subframes per repetition, not an application cycle.
nbi_sf_count.label: sf count

nbi_tb_bits.description: Actual selected grant transport block bits; not application payload or uncoded throughput.
nbi_tb_bits.label: tb bits

nbi_dl_tb_cap_bits.description: Normative selected category/optional DL16QAM capability bound; not installed grant.
nbi_dl_tb_cap_bits.label: dl tb cap bits

nbi_ul_tb_cap_bits.description: Normative selected category UL1000/2536bits; not arbitrary bytes or peakrate.
nbi_ul_tb_cap_bits.label: ul tb cap bits

nbi_soft_channel_bits.description: Normative category DL soft channel buffer, not free application RAM.
nbi_soft_channel_bits.label: soft channel bits

nbi_layer2_cap_bytes.description: Normative category4000/8000/12000byte L2capability, not assigned application queue.
nbi_layer2_cap_bytes.label: layer2 cap bytes

nbi_harq_processes.description: Actual configured one or two HARQ processes, optionalNB2capability separate.
nbi_harq_processes.label: harq processes

nbi_hd_guard_before_ms.description: TypeB half-duplex receive-to-transmit guard, not deadline.
nbi_hd_guard_before_ms.label: hd guard before ms

nbi_hd_guard_after_ms.description: TypeB half-duplex transmit-to-receive guard, not deadline.
nbi_hd_guard_after_ms.label: hd guard after ms

nbi_tdd_assignment.description: Actual eligible TDD UL/DL configuration for chosen ULspacing.
nbi_tdd_assignment.label: tdd assignment

nbi_functional_bound_ms.description: Actual functional complete E2Edeadline, separate from radio ACK.
nbi_functional_bound_ms.label: functional bound ms

nbi_nominal_max_power_dbm.description: Normative selected class nominal maximum23/20/14dBm, not actual output.
nbi_nominal_max_power_dbm.label: nominal max power dbm

nbi_output_power_dbm.description: Actual measured radiated/transmitted output with MPR/tolerance/source.
nbi_output_power_dbm.label: output power dbm

nbi_frequency_average_slots.description: Normative72/allocatedtone averaging count for actual frequency error.
nbi_frequency_average_slots.label: frequency average slots

nbi_packet_bytes.description: Actual encoded upper-layer bytes inclactualheader; may spanmultiple radio TBs.
nbi_packet_bytes.label: packet bytes

nbi_header_bytes.description: Actual upper-layer/security codec overhead; no universal IP/UDP/Ethernetheader.
nbi_header_bytes.label: header bytes

nbi_nas_base_timer_s.description: Actual applicable named NAS procedure timer from its own table.
nbi_nas_base_timer_s.label: nas base timer s

nbi_nas_timer_s.description: Actual applicable EMMbase+240s or ESMbase+180s inNB-S1, not application default.
nbi_nas_timer_s.label: nas timer s

nbi_t3412_raw.description: Actual GPRStimer3 octet unit/high3,value/low5, not an arbitrary lifetime.
nbi_t3412_raw.label: t3412 raw

nbi_t3412_value.description: Actual T3412 timer multiplier0..31, separate from unit and IE presence.
nbi_t3412_value.label: t3412 value

nbi_t3412_seconds.description: Decoded actual accepted T3412 extension;unit6 receiver/protection dependent.
nbi_t3412_seconds.label: t3412 seconds

nbi_t3324_raw.description: Actual GPRStimer2 octet, unit high3 and value low5.
nbi_t3324_raw.label: t3324 raw

nbi_t3324_value.description: Actual T3324 multiplier0..31;zero can mean immediatePSM, not missing.
nbi_t3324_value.label: t3324 value

nbi_t3324_seconds.description: Decoded actual active timer;deactivatedunit7 has no finite seconds.
nbi_t3324_seconds.label: t3324 seconds

nbi_edrx_raw.description: Actual octet PTWhigh4,eDRXlow4 forNB-S1, not LTE-Mtable.
nbi_edrx_raw.label: edrx raw

nbi_edrx_seconds.description: Decoded actual effective NB-S1 eDRX cycle20.48..10485.76s.
nbi_edrx_seconds.label: edrx seconds

nbi_ptw_seconds.description: Decoded actual NB-S1 PTW2.56..40.96s, not LTE-M1.28step.
nbi_ptw_seconds.label: ptw seconds

nbi_multi_tone_supported.description: Actual multiTone-r13 capability; mandatoryselectedRelease18, not assumedforotherrelease.
nbi_multi_tone_supported.label: multi tone supported

nbi_multi_carrier_supported.description: Actual multiCarrier-r13 capability; doesnotdoubleUEresourceblock or implyaggregation.
nbi_multi_carrier_supported.label: multi carrier supported

nbi_ul_16qam_supported.description: Actual optional band-qualified npusch-16QAM-r17 NB2unicast capability.
nbi_ul_16qam_supported.label: ul 16qam supported

nbi_cp_supported.description: Actual NB-S1 UE/network mandatoryCP CIoTsupport, not choiceofactualservicepath.
nbi_cp_supported.label: cp supported

nbi_s1u_supported.description: Actual S1-Udata-transfer capability, independently from CPoptimizeddelivery.
nbi_s1u_supported.label: s1u supported

parameter_constraints.source_revision: NB-IoT is not an addressed I2C transaction

parameter_proposals.note: NB1/NB2 has no fixed250kbit/s baseline or universal1500byte application payload. Own channel200kHz versus180kHz resource grid, UL3.75/15kHz, category/optional-QAM and actualgrants/repetitions/PSM/eDRX/core path determine service; no LTE-M/CAN/Ethernet fallback.

known_limitations: Technology-specific conformance details require a vendor/profile extension.
